IMG-ARM2-K3-mcc-oracle-unconstrained.label: IMG-ARM2-K3-mcc-oracle-unconstrained
IMG-ARM2-K3-mcc-oracle-unconstrained.superseded: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-20: the MCC oracle is now the tile-MCC optimum over prob_t at the rung's CARRIED vote count, which is the cell now at IMG-ARM2-K3-mcc-oracle. This is the previous, UNCONSTRAINED optimum, free to choose the vote count too; it is retained because every rung that had a choice put it at a single vote, at a large cost in micro-F1, and that is the finding. Not an oracle; do not quote it as one.

/rescored_in_place.to: RE-SCORED IN PLACE 2026-09-20: this cell was scored at its original path and then moved here, so its evaluation metadata (cli_args, input_files, input_git_state) still named cells/IMG-ARM2-K3-mcc-oracle/detections.geojson, which now holds the re-pointed carried-k cell; verify_run_conditions.py raised eval-detections-mismatch on the register row citing it. It was re-scored here on the same r2 recipe (14 buffers, tile-level BCa 10,000 at seed 42, --mcc, --require-clean-inputs) over the SAME, unmodified detections file, so every headline number and confidence interval is identical to the pre-move evaluation and only the metadata paths changed. The pre-move record is retained beside it as evaluation.pre-move-2026-09-20.{json,csv,md} and score.pre-move-2026-09-20.log.
